summary: Design agent completed Low-Level Design for FR-EDIT-001 (Issue #13) — Implement brick selection by click with visual highlight. LLD covers: component architecture (selectionManager.ts, selectionStore.ts, Viewport.tsx modification, BrickInstances.tsx new, useSelection.ts new), interface contracts (SelectionManagerInterface, SelectionStoreAccessor, UseSelectionReturn, BrickInstancesProps), data models (PlacedBrick, SelectionState, InstanceIndexMap), four sequence diagrams (happy path, re-selection, clear on empty click, empty scene), selection algorithm (BVH raycast → instanceId → brickId lookup), highlight algorithm (color multiply by HIGHLIGHT_FACTOR=1.8), error handling (5 conditions, all silent with console.warn), security considerations (UUID validation, hex color validation), performance budget (≤2ms raycast, 0 React re-renders via imperative InstancedMesh update), drag-vs-click disambiguation (DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX=4), test case mapping (T-BE-EDIT-001-01 through -03, T-E2E-EDIT-001-01), and 6 open questions/assumptions. Draft PR is open on branch feature/13-fr-edit-001-design awaiting Gate 6a human design review before merge to main.
